title: Storefront anchors (public/tiles/<world>/storefronts.json): where a shopfront sits on a building's ground-floor wall. No names, ever (storefronts stay unnamed).

id.description: Stable hashed id (never the source's own id)

y.description: Ground height at the anchor, metres

heading.description: Compass bearing the shopfront faces, radians clockwise from north

category.description: Iconography category for the storefront kit

buildingId.description: Collider building record the anchor sits on
